image.altZh: Kimi控制台显示Pro会员、本月用量7.15%、频限100%，当时约3小时1分钟后重置
image.altEn: Kimi console snapshot showing Pro membership, 7.15% monthly usage and 100% rate-limit usage, with about 3 hours 1 minute until reset
image.captionZh: 用户提供的本次评测控制台快照：本月用量7.15%，频限窗口100%，页面当时显示约3小时1分钟后重置。此图仅展示拍摄时状态。
image.captionEn: User-provided console snapshot from this evaluation: 7.15% monthly usage, 100% rate-limit usage and about 3 hours 1 minute until reset at capture time. This is a historical snapshot.

observation.descriptionZh: 这次用的是Pro会员，但评测还没跑完，就先撞到了5小时窗口的频限，接口返回429。本月用量7.15%与频限100%属于不同计量窗口，不能把这次限流说成月度额度用完。
observation.descriptionEn: This evaluation used a Pro membership, yet hit the five-hour usage limit before the suite finished, returning HTTP 429. The 7.15% monthly usage and 100% rate-limit usage describe different windows; this was not monthly-quota exhaustion.
